children: Seaport Research Partners initiated coverage of four semiconductor companies, assigning Buy ratings to Marvell

, while giving SiTime a Neutral rating.Seaport set a $270 price target for Marvell, saying it has significant growth ahead as demand increases for its interconnect and custom silicon businesses tied to artificial intelligence data centers.
MRVL currently trades at $262. Marvell's optical links are used across accelerator platforms, including Nvidia's, providing some protection against uncertainty over custom silicon customers.

Seaport said it would watch Marvell's gross margin, noting that the company's current-quarter non-GAAP gross margin guidance of 58.25% to 59.25% is below 59.4% a year earlier. It said expected operating leverage would come mainly from controlling operating expenses rather than gross margin expansion. For Semtech, Seaport set a $200 target, saying the company has shifted its focus toward data-center optical products and is positioned to benefit from AI-related optical demand in 2027 and 2028.On Semiconductor, which is benefiting from improving industrial and automotive demand for analog chips and could gain from the expected 800-volt data center buildout in 2027 and 2028, had its target at $100. ON trades at $72.77. It also viewed On Semi's planned Synaptics deal more favorably than the broader market, citing potential expansion into digital logic and gross-margin benefits.

Seaport said SiTime has made progress in its timing-products business and has further growth opportunities in AI data centers but believes much of that outlook is already reflected in the stock. SITM stock was down 4% on Wednesday, but the last six months' gains are 75%.

title: Seaport starts bullish on Marvell, Semtech, and On Semi
